P-RA.1.author: (a) realignment restores AUC by their criterion
P-RA.1.unit: cells: pair x fit pool (R_same, R_fresh, 1% traffic), clean fits; 27 per population
P-RA.1.quantity: Duan's repair criterion (DEVIATIONS (j)) on the D-156 means over the 200 draws of the seed-mean AUROC on E and the eval positives: pre (A_base), stale probe (A_frozen), realigned (A_arm)
P-RA.1.rule: HELD iff at least 80% of the population's cells pass; a cell with a missing value is a MISS (counted, not passing; D-322 (4)); scored per population (Phase 1 released, Phase 2 headline)
P-RA.1.share_from: D-177 (3)'s 80% as D-327 (4), D-332 (5) and D-361 (3) P2-M.2 apply it to cells

P-RA.2.author: (b) it leaves the FPR at the frozen threshold outside x1.5 of target in a registered share of pairs
P-RA.2.unit: pairs: the realignment fitted on R_same (the trusted stored reference, the items of the R_same recalibration beside it); 9 per population
P-RA.2.quantity: the D-156 mean over the 200 draws of FPR/target at T_d (seed mean of per-seed FPRs floored at 1/|E|) of realign|R_same
P-RA.2.rule: a pair counts iff |log(FPR/target)| > log 1.5 (outside x1.5, D-177); HELD iff at least 6 of the 9 pairs count; a missing value does not count (D-322 (4)); per population
P-RA.2.share_from: D-383 (4) P-MLP.1's 'in at least 6 of the 9' (the pair-count convention of a C1-type miss)

P-RA.3.author: (c) the two-moment model predicts the realised FPR (cells, x1.5)
P-RA.3.unit: cells: pair x fit pool, clean realignment fits; 27 per population
P-RA.3.quantity: realised: the D-156 mean of FPR/target of realign|<pool>; predicted: the D-156 mean of twomoment_cells' moment_full_in_sample (D-361 (1) PRIMARY, unchanged): per draw and seed E's pre scores moment-matched (mean and full SD) to E's realigned scores, at T_d, floored at 1/|E|, over the target
P-RA.3.rule: HELD iff at least 80% of the cells have |log(realised/predicted)| <= log 1.5; the median |log| is reported with n cells (D-177); a zero, undefined or missing prediction is a MISS (D-322 (4)); per population

P-RA.4.author: (d) the A1 poison sets at rho <= 1% move that FPR by x2 or more
P-RA.4.unit: cells: pair x fit pool; 27 per population
P-RA.4.quantity: r(rho) = (D-156 mean FPR of the map refitted on the pool plus 4d B's A1 injections at rho) / (D-156 mean FPR of the clean fit), rho in {0.001, 0.0025, 0.005, 0.01} (4d B's grid at or below 1%, D-244 (6)), m = round(rho x 1000); the injection sets are 4d B's (transfer only)
P-RA.4.rule: a cell is MOVED iff r(rho) >= 2 or r(rho) <= 0.5 at some rho of the four (D-241 (3)'s x2 cut; the smallest such rho is recorded, D-244 (6)'s minimum-rho convention); HELD iff at least 80% of the cells are MOVED; a missing value is not moved (D-322 (4)); per population

implementation_choices: (a) PROCRUSTES, the canonical minimiser (verified against a brute-force construction to 1e-10 in the tests): centred and unscaled as the project's Procrustes of record (repair_d156.procrustes, D-093/D-094, D-218); since n = 1000 < d leaves R free off the fit items' span, the minimiser closest to the identity (largest trace) is used, in closed form (module docstring), from the thin row-space bases of the two centred fit blocks (Gram eigendecomposition, one Newton-Schulz polish), the bases' ranks cut at 1e-07 of the block's largest singular value and the cross-covariance's at 1e-12 of its own (a numerical-rank floor: every real cross direction stays in the span, so R is the minimiser there, F-085; the dropped counts recorded per fit on the frozen split). Rejected: LAPACK's arbitrary completion (repair_d156.procrustes as is): it depends on the library and the item order, not on the data; the minimum-norm partial isometry (not orthogonal, so not a Procrustes map). The difference between the canonical and the LAPACK map on E's scores is recorded on the frozen split (how much the choice matters).

(b) ENGINE: realign_d418.run_draws, arm_summaries and duan_block unchanged; for a Procrustes unit only the module names fit_map and map_scores are swapped for the duration of the call (map_form, restored on exit), so every arm, pool, A1 set, control and two-moment prediction is computed by D-418's reviewed lines. The arms keep D-418's names ('realign|<pool>' is the map arm of whichever map the record names in config.map), so realign_d418.score_population scores every unit unchanged.

(c) DRAWS: ridge units take D-418's registered 200 draws; Procrustes units the frozen split plus the FIRST 50 (the draws are prefix-stable: draw d is seeded by d, so draw d here is D-418's draw d), priced in the lists; the D-156 means of a Procrustes unit are over 50 draws, recorded in every record and in the summary.

(d) LoRA LOADING: phase3_a3_predictions.load_inputs's checks line for line, with the selection read from the LoRA selection of record (depth_d156.SELECTION_OF_RECORD_LORA, its one model depth_d156.LORA_SELECTION_PAIR: the A100 base every arm shares, D-171, D-224), which must be the file, sha256, C and layer the run's depth_d156 record names; then phase3_a3_predictions.build unchanged (4d B's partitions, pools, probes, T_d and A1 rule on the run's own H, as D-418 (4) applies 4d B's rule to Phase 2's H).
(e) ANCHORS: as the module docstring. A LoRA run has no 4d B record, so it anchors on its depth_d156 record of record at L* (the frozen split's per-seed counts exactly, the AUROCs within AUROC_TOL).

(f) UNITS and SCORING: four new units (population x map), each scored separately with realign_d418.score_population (P-RA.1-4, D-418's text and thresholds; 9 pairs and 27 cells per unit); the author's 'none pooled, none privileged' - no unit is primary over another and no verdict pools units.

(g) LANES: lane C first (the author, 2026-10-09: 'Put the new CPU jobs on lane C first. Chain behind D-418 on A or D only what C cannot hold'): lane C carries the predictions job and the eighteen LoRA jobs (ridge, then Procrustes), which need nothing of D-418; the Phase 1 and Phase 2 Procrustes jobs anchor on D-418's record of the same pair, which exists only once D-418's lane has run that pair, so lane C cannot hold them: the nine Phase 2 Procrustes jobs go behind D-418 on lane A and the nine Phase 1 Procrustes jobs behind D-418 on lane D (the lane that wrote their anchors), each list opening with a wait for lane C's predictions job (realign_d418.wait_command's form). (Amended before any load from D-423 (6)'s first split, which put Phase 1 Procrustes on C and LoRA Procrustes on D: D-418 had run only three of nine pairs per lane at 05:15Z on 2026-10-09.) The manifest and the summary run after the three lanes. ONE sonnet reviewer (the author's rule for this item, as D-418 (8)).

(i) NUMERICS (the review of 2026-10-09): the row-space bases are re-orthonormalised by Newton-Schulz steps to BASIS_TOL 1e-13 (the Gram route squares the condition number); both gaps are recorded per job on the frozen split. AMENDED 2026-10-10 (F-085, after the node sandbox): the review's relative OPT_TOL 1e-6 for directions dropped below RANK_RTOL is withdrawn: those directions were real (Mistral's fit pools: cross singular values at 1e-9 to 1e-7 of the largest, 11-15 of 999), cutting them left R off the minimiser on the fit items' span (fit scores 0.07-0.21 from LAPACK's), so the cross-covariance is now cut at CROSS_RTOL and OPT_TOL is D-423 (3)'s 1e-9.
(h) POPULATION GROUP: none until the pull (D-418 CHOICES (r)).

(j) SVD FALLBACK (D-437, the author's case (b) of 2026-10-11; F-089): LAPACK's np.linalg.svd of the principal-angle matrix M = Ur^T Vr raised 'SVD did not converge' on a FINITE M in the control_selfmap arm (src == tgt, so M is the identity to 1e-12: every singular value 1 +- 5e-13; lanes D and A, draws 14 and 38, docs/reports_d437/svd_diag_*.json); the same call on M^T converged. Only when np.linalg.svd(M) raises, M's SVD is taken from np.linalg.svd(M^T) (M = (W^T) S (Z^T) for M^T = Z S W), else from the eigendecomposition of M^T M (V; U = M V / s, re-orthonormalised by QR, its columns sign-aligned with M V / s); the result must reconstruct M to SVD_FALLBACK_TOL or the job refuses. Converged fits are untouched (bit-identical); no pair or draw is dropped; every fallback is recorded with its draw, arm and method in the record's svd_fallbacks (the count in n_svd_fallbacks).
